notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sorry for the lack of news, we've been very busy working on our upcoming game, Rip Them Off.

[b]Swim Out's update 1.4 is finally here ![/b]

It brings a few more cutscenes that appear when you win a level. Hope you'll enjoy them !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29637924/78b44131ed7b3ff3d3b64477aa628d7da0fe485a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29637924/d22cdf6ce652aa4ce0f92624003a476d3ba9c4b8.gif[/img]

If you enjoy Swim Out, please consider leaving a review, thanks !

In other news, in a few days we'll be releasing our new game, Rip Them Off. Exciting times ! You can add it to your wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295860/Rip_Them_Off/

Best,

Mat + AvA

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

[b]8 new achievements[/b] have been added when you complete all objectives of a chapter, and all objectives of the whole game.

If you’ve been enjoying Swim Out, [b]please take a moment to rate it[/b] or write a comment, thanks for your support!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29637924/6b7996c866aa50239f0dc3deca8dce5cd48384f5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

Swim Out is free of any text and so is [b]suitable for all languages[/b]. It's now up to date on Steam page.

We took this opportunity to update the following content :

[list]
[*] A [b]new objective[/b] has been added to Level VII-15 
[*] Support for screen larger than 16/9. Enjoy the scenery from a broader point of view!
[*] Minor improvements and bugfixes
[/list]

If you’ve been enjoying Swim Out, [b]please take a moment to rate it[/b] or write a comment.
Thanks for your support!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29637924/697a99642e523a69960ddaedbc277e5ff1a5eba7.png[/img]
